prompt:
I need the front end for CoverWell State Enrollment. The state's public portal where Medicaid members choose, confirm and change their managed-care health plan during their selection window.

Who's using it: Angela Reyes, 34, a home-health aide and single mother renewing Medicaid coverage for herself and her 9-year-old son, Mateo, who has moderate asthma. She is careful but not an insurance expert, and she's doing this on her lunch break.

What they're doing right now: Her renewal letter says she has until Dec 1 to pick a plan, or the state will auto-assign one that doesn't include Mateo's pulmonologist. She has narrowed it to two plans. She needs to confirm that her chosen plan covers both of their doctors and Mateo's inhaler, submit the selection, and understand exactly how she could switch if something turns out wrong. The state allows one change without cause within 90 days of enrollment.

What's in the system at this point: 4 available plans in her county: Harborline Health, Sunvale Community Care, Meridian Family Plan, and TriCounty Health Partners (the auto-assignment default). Her providers: Dr. Kim Osei (her primary care, in Harborline and Sunvale), Dr. Raj Patel (Mateo's pediatric pulmonologist, in Sunvale and Meridian), and Valley Children's Clinic. Medication: fluticasone/salmeterol inhaler, which is on the preferred formulary for Sunvale and Harborline but needs prior authorization at Meridian. Pharmacy: Westgate Pharmacy, in all 4 networks. Coverage would start Jan 1, 2027. Case number MC-0448-21937. Change rule: one change without cause by Mar 31, 2027. After she submits, she gets a confirmation number and the state mails a letter within 10 days.

Build it as a working web app, opened in the state that person would see at that moment. No backend: use realistic mock data (no lorem ipsum, no placeholder names), and make the interactive parts actually work client-side.

Use whatever framework and tooling you like. When you're done there must be a static production build in ./out with ./out/index.html as the entry point. It will be served from the root of a plain static file server (no rewrites, no server code) and viewed in a desktop browser at 1440×900.
